parse_schema: parse a MuJoCo MJCF schema XML file and return an ElementSpec for the root element
override_schema: override the default MUJOCO schema with a custom schema XML file path
collect_namespaces: collect all findable namespaces from a given ElementSpec and return them as a set
ElementSpec: create an ElementSpec namedtuple with name, repeated, on_demand, identifier, namespace, attributes, and children fields
AttributeSpec: create an AttributeSpec namedtuple with name, type, required, conflict_allowed, conflict_behavior, and other_kwargs fields
